scope: Independent all-member Cartesian reconstruction, exact positive half-weights, physical partner mapping, no duplicated old archive, and all fixed gate decisions. No producer physics imports or fresh ODE solves.

comparison_normalization.interpretation: All scales are positive. A 5% gate does not mean 5% relative accuracy in a small signed mean or cross moment. Fixed sample, scramble and partition comparisons are empirical; no confidence interval or continuous-domain bound follows.

normalized_kick_ratio.scope: Finite-band normalized squared-kick ratio only; no relaxation/mixing time or plasma closure.

inverse_cutoff_diagnostic.scope: Each physical original and partner retains half its exact incoming mass, including reflected exits; no extra outgoing flux factor or detailed-balance claim.
